direct_strings.limitation: allowlist keys can cover multiple sites; detector shapes do not cover all hardcoded strings

coverage_boundaries.fluent: all 1576 IDs in each of four locale sets; not all hardcoded UI strings
coverage_boundaries.non_fluent: complete source links at the pinned commit; not a flattened string table

digest_boundary: manifest excludes its own digest and SHA256SUMS; SHA256SUMS covers the manifest and all other files except itself
disclosure_status: requires disclosure review before publication; see disclosure-review.json
source_requirement: exact HEAD; clean tracked and untracked worktree before and after export
